scope: Audit metadata only. Candidate targets are neither an import whitelist nor an implemented variant. Raw sample copies at /Game remain preserved. Existing project-owned references need semantic review before reuse.

registry.limitation: Recursive hard/soft package references, including editor-only; management queried separately. Dynamic paths and loaded/runtime/cooked closure are not proven.

excluded_from_first_pilot: sample shooting, spawning, NPC auto-getup and obstacle demo logic
sample camera/visual overrides as gameplay owners
shared baseline or source asset overwrite
corpse retention, downed/revive and new health/respawn systems

export_limitations.reflection_coverage: All seven snapshots are partial; unreadable fields are counted per source. Native T3D supplements do not establish complete semantic parity.
export_limitations.interpretation: Exporter failures are not evidence of malformed source graphs. Use full graph identity and pins in snapshots/native exports for audited findings.

graph_landmarks.observation: Source queues local Ragdoll/Walking modes; every exit from Ragdoll enters getup without an RPG death gate.
Physics-derived bone transform/orientation enters Mover input data. This is not proof of server validation.
Source consumes ragdoll input, ground sphere trace and TrySafeMoveAndSlide with bSweep=false, then publishes Mover sync state.
Mesh -> post-ABP tick -> PhysicsControl prerequisites; four animation curves scale ParentSpace control strengths.
Game-thread Pawn interfaces populate local animation read models. Ragdoll graph property access consumes these; no blanket thread/network parity proof.
